digest.component_or_area: plan-review batch runner and pass-1 pipeline
propositions: Pass-1 findings are returned without attached usage dictionaries, causing token totals and per-criterion call counts to be lost in batch outputs and coverage metrics

The three pass functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) return only findings lists instead of (findings, usage) tuples, breaking the chain that threads usage through the runner, sizing, and batch layers
Per-criterion request and call counts extracted by the runner are never persisted, preventing data-driven criterion optimization decisions
The prerequisite finder returns (records, findings) without usage accumulators, so prerequisite call costs are absent from final batch-runner metrics
Checkpoint-served chunks and ladder-retry attempts need differentiated handling: completed attempts contribute usage records while raising attempts and cached chunks contribute nothing

Multi-criterion chunks must split token fields equally across covered criteria while counting requests and derived llm_calls in full per criterion, with both rules applied uniformly in aggregation and sidecar payload
